guitar.evidence: Carlos Santana has played a PRS Santana signature model since the late 1970s/80s; it's his most iconic and longest-associated instrument, though he used Gibson SG and Yamaha SG earlier in his career.
guitar.notes: Simplified to lead with the PRS Santana as primary, since that is the truly iconic/signature instrument; kept others as historical context implicitly.

tone.target: santana lead with nasal wah and singing sustain
tone.profile: santana lead with nasal wah and singing sustain
tone.summary: Gate -> Boost (OD 9) -> Wah (V-Wah) -> DST (Red Haze) -> AMP (AC30 TB) -> CAB/IR (UK Vintage 4x12) -> EQ (Guitar EQ 2) -> MOD (Chorus) -> DLY (Digital Delay) -> RVB (Room)

rig.name: Carlos Santana - Soul Sacrifice - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide smooth, controlled overdrive for lead sustain and attack.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate the initial grit of a tube preamp without excessive distortion.

blocks.purpose: Crucial for the signature nasal sweep and vocal quality.
Add harmonic richness and singing sustain without sounding overly aggressive.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated tube saturation model would be ideal, Red Haze provides the necessary mid-focus grit.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British voicing and mid-forward punch required for lead tones.
blocks.gap: The AC30 is chosen over UK 45/UK 50 to emphasize the rounder, singing quality associated with Santana's sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic, articulate British cabinet sound that complements the AC30.
Aggressively boost the mid-range frequencies to achieve maximum 'singing' sustain and presence.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is necessary to carve out the specific vocal frequency range of Santana's leads.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle width and movement to the sustained notes without distracting from the lead melody.
blocks.gap: A very gentle chorus is used here, as excessive modulation would muddy the tone. This adds a 'creamier' quality.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the sustained notes without creating distracting delay trails.
blocks.gap: The settings are kept low (low feedback/mix) to provide ambience rather than rhythmic echo, fulfilling the 'avoid delay trails' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural, warm sense of space to round out the overall tone.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture the mid-forward, singing sustain and roundness of Santana's tone.

proposals.reason: Greenbacks or V30s provide the round, singing mid-focus needed for Santana's signature lead tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased warmth and sustain in the mids.
